data.body: [P1] Publish root-handler JVM fatals before closing handler scopes. A handler `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath` is not recorded until `handlerFuture` settles, but `runHandler` settles only after every handler scope closes. A blocking close can therefore prevent the 500 ms fatal handoff and hold the invocation until timeout; a second fatal from `close()` can also replace the handler failure. Catch and unwrap JVM fatals around `handler.apply`, call `recordInvocationFatal` before scope unwinding, preserve that failure as primary, and add blocking/failing-close coverage.
